input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, matching the preferred playbook position exactly, with a carve-out permitting either Party (including us) to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere. A document-wide search returns no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign arbitration seat. The Section 28.3 pre-suit executive escalation is mutual and expressly states it "does not delay urgent relief or a filing needed to preserve a limitations period," so it does not bar urgent relief. No redline needed.
